title: GPT-6 Astra × img2threejs - turning 3D assets into an actual Three.js game
author: Feisty-Scheme-8356
selftext:
I’ve been testing **GPT-6 Astra with the img2threejs pipeline**, and this is probably my most game-like result so far.

This time I pushed beyond just reconstructing a character, multiple skins, animation ranges, VFX, lighting, and game-like interactions, all built around Three.js.

For the different skins, I generated the reference assets with Hyper3D and simply asked the agent to **use the img2threejs skill and integrate the new skin into the character**.

What I find interesting is that the 3D asset is no longer the final output. It becomes an input to the img2threejs pipeline, and the agent can continue building the actual interactive experience around it.

Still experimenting, but **GPT-6 Astra × img2threejs × Three.js** is getting much closer to something I could use for rapid game prototyping.

Would love to hear what you guys think.
